@graph.name: Should I look for an Orderly alternative to get voice ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Orderly is food cost management built from your invoices, and ordering is already part of it. Where one of your suppliers hands you our app, orders to them can be spoken instead.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Orderly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at food cost, invoices, recipe costing or paying bills: we offer none of those. Ours is one narrow job, an order said out loud to your distributor and checked one line at a time. If ordering is what made you look for an Orderly alternative, that job beside Orderly may cover it.

@graph.name: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and Orderly connect?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is no link between them, no data passes either way, and there is no shared support. Each one does its own job.

@graph.name: Can I order from every supplier with VoiceOrder Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, only from distributors that offer it. Orderly lets you order from all your vendors, and we cannot, so stay with it for the others. You can also ask your other suppliers whether they use our app.

@graph.name: What if I say one item and a different one shows up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fix it or delete it on the review screen before you send. That check is your safeguard, so read it properly: a rushed glance can still let a mistake through. Anything phoned in or left on voicemail gets no order number from us; only orders sent in the app do.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through your distributor: once they set up your account, most restaurants put their first order through that same day. Not sure whether yours is on VoiceOrder Solutions? Get in touch, and we can find out for you. As for cost, ask the distributor, since they hand out the app; we list no price of our own. Orderly, by contrast, publishes its prices.

@graph.name: Will Orderly still show what that delivery cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Orderly costs a delivery from its invoice, not from the order, so snap, scan or sync that invoice as you do today and the cost shows up like any other. The spoken order is the only part Orderly never sees.
